records.title: Reopened status is overridden by executor gate membership
records.existing_behavior: A partial row without parked_on can inherit a gate through executor tuples; 20 reopened rows are hidden as gated.
records.required_behavior: Explicit reopening must take precedence; distinguish executable residue from a valid external dependency.

records.title: Module reachability is mistaken for requirement proof
records.existing_behavior: Closure accepts existence of reachable named machinery without tracing the required output and action.
records.required_behavior: Reachability is necessary evidence, not sufficient proof of the requirement.

records.title: Unchecked gates can coexist with closed_out
records.existing_behavior: Missing DB or gate-read errors are labelled unchecked, but closed_out still follows OPEN count.
records.required_behavior: Do not present unchecked gate state as verified closure.

records.title: Unique-value comparison permits unmeasured or unsupported superiority
records.existing_behavior: Certificate capabilities are compared to lower benchmark scores; unmeasured unique value does not block.
records.required_behavior: An advantage must be established on comparable evidence for the actual product; retain the requirement's refusal semantics.

records.title: Delight scores are fixed proxies and can use another version
records.existing_behavior: Artifact/certificate presence yields fixed delight scores; slug-wide artifacts may span versions.
records.required_behavior: Keep capability proxies distinct from product-specific measured delight and real improvement effects.

records.title: Frame review can clear unjudged, empty or stale evidence
records.existing_behavior: Described deterministic frames may convert unjudged to clear; empty maps and slug/version lookup do not establish full hash-bound review.
records.required_behavior: Review every required current frame for applicable claims; unknown stays unknown; changed bytes invalidate approval.

records.title: Polling backoff grows without a new observation
records.existing_behavior: Repeated sweeps reuse the same DONE tail and extend suppression from now.
records.required_behavior: Backoff increments only after a newly completed unchanged attempt and eventually allows a probe.

records.title: New build SHA stands in for changed failure hypothesis
records.existing_behavior: Any new commit can release a tripped loop.
records.required_behavior: Retry must name changed relevant conditions or hypothesis and retain the cost/retry ceiling.

records.title: Lane enforcement needs atomic concurrent admission
records.existing_behavior: Capacity is evaluated around queue claiming; serial tests do not establish concurrent limits.
records.required_behavior: Concurrent workers must neither exceed lane/function capacity nor mutually defer all runnable work.

records.title: Rebuild completion is not strictly request-bound
records.existing_behavior: Completion checks emphasize fresh artifact rows and stage dispatch.
records.required_behavior: Completion must match requested artifact identities, dependencies/fingerprints and the actual rebuild attempt.

records.title: Escalation plans do not prove distinct rung execution
records.existing_behavior: Live gates allow a rung and photography job is enqueued with a reason.
records.required_behavior: Each attempted strategy must change the intended inputs/tool/composition and progress only on evaluated results.

records.title: Launch readiness uses weak rollback and baseline proxies
records.existing_behavior: Recent continuity.verified existence and generic readings/SEO can stand in for rollback and analytics readiness.
records.required_behavior: Readiness must cite successful relevant restore evidence and an identified prelaunch analytics baseline.

records.title: Experiment cost attribution is partly a job-type proxy
records.existing_behavior: Unlabelled exploration jobs receive exploration:<job_type> pseudo-experiment labels.
records.required_behavior: Separate actual experiment IDs from unattributed/category spend; do not claim per-experiment evidence for proxies.

records.title: Continuous critical-dependency actions remain absent
records.existing_behavior: No new scheduled dependency mapping/probe/recovery-strategy consumer in preserved patches.
records.required_behavior: Existing dependency inventory must be refreshed and missing backup/recovery strategies or failed probes must produce proportional action.

records.title: Validated-products-per-dollar optimization remains absent
records.existing_behavior: Experiment/job attribution and ROI work do not supply every required unit cost or scheduled optimization consumer.
records.required_behavior: Track the specified artifacts/minutes/costs and optimize using actual validated output and contribution.

records.title: Recognizability without model remains unevidenced
records.existing_behavior: Inventory has hand-set existence flags; new layout checks do not measure model-free brand recognizability.
records.required_behavior: Evidence must cover the master's named brand signatures and product-first continuity.

records.title: Opportunity scorers do not consume evidence freshness/population weighting
records.existing_behavior: Source/date additions do not show weight/currentness checks consumed by new scorers; seller location is misused separately.
records.required_behavior: Preserve source/window/population and discount stale/mismatched evidence before selection or current-demand claims.

records.title: Seasonal takeover has plans but no proven apply/revert executor
records.existing_behavior: Seasonal plans/collection rows do not execute or restore storefront changes.
records.required_behavior: Due transitions and reversion must pass authorized surface/quality gates and be durably recoverable.

records.title: Receipt state is not reconciled for late full or partial refunds
records.existing_behavior: Existing external refs return early; any receipt refund marks all lines refunded; creation-time overlap misses old updates.
records.required_behavior: Represent current payment/refund truth per transaction and reconcile changes without double counting; discover updates to old receipts.

records.title: Unpaid and cancelled receipts can become sales
records.existing_behavior: Normalization does not check paid/cancelled state before writing revenue.
records.required_behavior: Only eligible paid transactions count as sales; cancelled/unpaid/unknown states have explicit non-sale treatment.

records.title: Historical sale versions are assigned from current listing state
records.existing_behavior: Current listing version is assigned to imported historical transactions.
records.required_behavior: Bind sale to the delivered version or retain unknown; do not fabricate historical certainty.

records.title: Out-of-order history corrupts first-purchase and repeat cohorts
records.existing_behavior: First customer record reflects first encountered receipt, which need not be earliest chronologically.
records.required_behavior: First acquisition/product and repeat classification must be invariant to arrival order.

records.title: Crash can leave order without version or ledger evidence
records.existing_behavior: Customer, order, version and ledger writes span separate transactions; duplicate order path can bypass missing dependent writes.
records.required_behavior: Restart must converge to a complete, exactly-once logical transaction with traceable partial state.

records.title: Unknown Etsy acquisition becomes organic and loop counters resist correction
records.existing_behavior: Generic Etsy acquisition is mapped to organic; non-negative deltas cannot represent downward corrections.
records.required_behavior: Unknown attribution stays unknown; loop metrics reconcile refunds/corrections and distinguish event counts from net outcomes.

records.title: Negative contribution is suppressed and fee estimates can look measured
records.existing_behavior: Contribution is clamped to zero; fee calculation is modelled while FX assumption is explicitly labelled.
records.required_behavior: Retain losses and mark estimated versus measured money inputs end to end.

records.title: Pricing and offer guards may annotate rather than prevent actions
records.existing_behavior: Discount/net guards can add reasons while returning a price; offer guard edits coexist with portfolio classification/actions.
records.required_behavior: Disallowed discounts, impossible net floors and protected retirement must stop their actual downstream action.

records.title: Certification is treated as correction without correction scope
records.existing_behavior: New certified versions update current_safe_version and prepare notices without demonstrated correction-specific trigger.
records.required_behavior: Distinguish routine versions from correction releases and approved releasability; prepare notices only for affected buyers.

records.title: North-star metrics use draft and research proxies
records.existing_behavior: Listing existence and upstream research survival can stand in for actual launch and engineering outcomes.
records.required_behavior: Compute each named metric from its actual lifecycle event; unavailable observations remain unmeasured.

records.title: Third steering run repeats priority movement
records.existing_behavior: Daily reading is overwritten: first run moves, second skips and erases movement history, third can move again.
records.required_behavior: Repeated execution of the same steering decision must be idempotent across runs and restarts.

records.title: Steering escapes protected priority bands
records.existing_behavior: Growth mutates priority by raw credits while Improve bounds changes within a band.
records.required_behavior: One priority authority must preserve customer/truth protection and bounded permitted urgency.

records.title: Fast-lane targeted rebuild request is not consumed
records.existing_behavior: Growth emits slugs, Platform selects targeted behavior from artefacts; request may fall through to broad scan.
records.required_behavior: Contract must explicitly resolve requested slugs to scoped release/artifact targets or reject unsupported input.

records.title: Commercial evidence has consumers but no normal producer
records.existing_behavior: Review stars, creator references and offsite/paid attribution appear in fixtures but are not populated by the saved receipt writer.
records.required_behavior: Connect supported evidence sources with provenance or remain unmeasured; never infer missing commercial truth.

records.title: Blank agreements can pass tester graduation
records.existing_behavior: Caller supplies empty testing_terms/ambassador_terms and returns graduated references; checker can permit reliability+consent without actual terms.
records.required_behavior: Verify separate actual agreements and consent before relationship transition; eligibility is not completed graduation.

records.title: Distribution plans are not executable production chains
records.existing_behavior: Plans and checks are recorded; tutorial refs may be constructed strings; flow design selection does not prove the chosen causal plan fits.
records.required_behavior: Every claimed produced/distributed result needs a real consumer; unavailable external surfaces stay gated.

records.title: Club cadence uses release spacing and lacks feasibility input
records.existing_behavior: Release interarrival is used as cadence evidence; platform feasibility remains unanswered.
records.required_behavior: Separate throughput observations from production lead time and answer only supported feasibility inputs.

records.title: Support draft timing can prevent later delivery measurement
records.existing_behavior: Once response_minutes exists, the draft-ready path may never transition to a measured delivered response.
records.required_behavior: Track draft-ready and sent/received timing separately; trust uses actual delivered service.

records.title: Unknown traffic and absent contribution distort benchmark readings
records.existing_behavior: Unknown traffic defaults to etsy_search; opportunity input passes contribution_per_order_cad=None.
records.required_behavior: Maintain unknown source and compute contribution only from reconciled matching observations; no measured ranking from absent inputs.

records.title: Calibration can score overlapping or missing observations as actuals
records.existing_behavior: Outcome-period sums do not establish disjoint coverage; missing observations can become measured zero.
records.required_behavior: Forecast evaluation requires complete comparable actual windows, deduplication and explicit missingness.

records.title: Planning-time ads gates are not an execution-time guarantee
records.existing_behavior: Planner checks trust/organic evidence; campaign handler has authority checks but currently refuses live execution because integration is absent.
records.required_behavior: Before any future protected spend, re-read current authority, trust, eligibility, listing state and budgets atomically enough to prevent stale-plan bypass.

records.title: Experiment rank changes may only reorder the dashboard
records.existing_behavior: steer_rank is consumed in board sorting; executor selection is not demonstrated.
records.required_behavior: Continuous execution must consume the selected constraint/rank without weakening experiment gates.

records.title: Ads eligibility countdown and credit/cash separation are absent
records.existing_behavior: Saved patches contain ad planning but no shop waiting-period expiry recheck or Etsy Plus credit/cash separation.
records.required_behavior: Retain the owner's explicit countdown requirement using verified current shop evidence; no invented date or spend.

records.title: Winner judgement contract lacks a proven production writer
records.existing_behavior: Intake consumes named concept judgement evidence that tests inject; all required quality judgements lack a demonstrated normal producer.
records.required_behavior: Actual judge jobs must emit hash-bound, named, independent evidence for every mandatory check; absence holds engineering.

records.title: Reconsideration misses changed prerequisite evidence
records.existing_behavior: Held-winner reconsideration observes a limited set of judgement changes.
records.required_behavior: Any relevant new grid/top-decile/capability evidence should trigger bounded idempotent reconsideration.

records.title: Gap progression can attach to the wrong arena
records.existing_behavior: Gap lookup can use first gap in a pod rather than exact originating gap/event.
records.required_behavior: Carry exact gap, event, arena and winning design identity through every stage.

records.title: Pipeline report advances on artifact or listing existence
records.existing_behavior: Asset rows and listing existence can satisfy stages without approved current release evidence; full scaling/lessons tail is absent.
records.required_behavior: Each stage must have the required result and consumer for that exact release; missing terminal stages remain incomplete.

records.title: Draft age can become launch-failure evidence
records.existing_behavior: Failure timing can use Listing.created_at rather than publication/exposure.
records.required_behavior: No launch failure without verified launch age and sufficient observable opportunity; source absence differs from zero sales.

records.title: Seller language is labelled buyer evidence
records.existing_behavior: Observed seller listing-title phrases feed buyer-language claims.
records.required_behavior: Distinguish seller wording from measured buyer queries; preserve source and population.

records.title: Breakthrough and cardigan end-to-end scope remains unfinished
records.existing_behavior: Saved cardigan test ends with no prototype winner/CIR; other breakthrough variants lack demonstrated completed chain.
records.required_behavior: Implement the specified design/engineering/visual progression or retain exact honest blocker; do not rename a stopped-path test success as product completion.

records.title: Funnel evidence must bind the actual concept payload
records.existing_behavior: Funnel lookup is slug-based; mutated payload reuse was not proved safe.
records.required_behavior: Only the carried concept/version/hash may use its funnel evidence.

records.title: Rollback state commits before rollback effect
records.existing_behavior: cells.revert commits REVERTED before ROLLBACKS executes; next scan selects PROMOTED only.
records.required_behavior: After failure/restart, rollback remains pending until the active configuration/floor is restored and verified.

records.title: Replay model differs from multi-worker runtime
records.existing_behavior: Single-worker daily simulation omits actual pool/lane behavior; unknown durations default and DEAD jobs can lose failure meaning; current proof can leak into history.
records.required_behavior: Replay claims must be scoped to faithfully simulated behavior; promotion must preserve protected bands and account for actual worker/lane semantics.

records.title: New replay record can be mistaken for fresh post-promotion evidence
records.existing_behavior: Run timestamp after promotion may refer to unchanged historical tasks; identity uses coarse window/count evidence.
records.required_behavior: Freshness must bind task identities/content/windows and independent post-promotion outcomes; reused holdout is not fresh evidence.

records.title: Registered test filenames are not test execution provenance
records.existing_behavior: Version registration populates tests_run from static filename tuples without running tests.
records.required_behavior: Separate declared validation coverage from actual executed result tied to source/environment.

records.title: Lesson matches receive invented currency-valued priority
records.existing_behavior: Each matching engineering lesson can add fixed CAD value; acted_on can describe a nudge without demonstrated benefit.
records.required_behavior: Heuristic priority must not appear as measured expected business value or realized learning benefit.

records.title: Adopting an audit floor does not implement the underlying improvement
records.existing_behavior: A better self-audit can promote a floor; support obligations can be attached without proof the artifact/reply changes.
records.required_behavior: Trace proposal to a specific implemented change, independent reevaluation and actual consuming artifact/response.

records.title: Self-audits and keyword checks can certify wrong content
records.existing_behavior: Self scores use brambleloop:<slug>; support text presence can substitute semantic clarity.
records.required_behavior: Bind audits to release/content hashes and compare applicable benchmark scope; keyword presence alone cannot prove correctness.

records.title: Taste and function-quality heuristics overstate independent quality
records.existing_behavior: Common pairings/novelty margins label taste; function metrics use broad row counts and role attribution proxies.
records.required_behavior: Label screening heuristics and evidence limits; reward observed quality/outcomes rather than row production.

records.title: Priority-policy replay is not a general challenger engine
records.existing_behavior: Actual replay covers job-priority configurations; other versions and specialist additions can be metadata/owner cards.
records.required_behavior: State implemented challenger scope accurately; model/tool evaluation and approved architecture execution need their own real paths.

records.title: Veto withholding must survive all rebuild paths
records.existing_behavior: Improve audits and returns withheld on veto; Platform separately persists certificate withholding for other gates.
records.required_behavior: One durable release eligibility record must represent all withholding reasons and all downstream paths must consume it.

records.title: Repeated unchanged policy snapshot erases unreviewed change
records.existing_behavior: Only latest snapshot is examined; A→B sets changed, B→B sets false and can resolve block without review.
records.required_behavior: Unreviewed material change remains blocking until review/test evidence covers the effective changed version.

records.title: Distinctiveness is substituted for top-decile strength
records.existing_behavior: Closed-vocabulary difference score can pass top-decile check when judged strength is absent.
records.required_behavior: Measure required concept/presentation strength comparably on current category evidence; rarity is only one input.

records.title: Fabric swatch does not prove finished-product visual fidelity
records.existing_behavior: Board renders capped prototype fabric raster, crops square and resizes; silhouette/assembly not established.
records.required_behavior: Treat swatch as material evidence only; preserve CIR→faithful finished-product 3D reference→photoreal image→truth/benchmark validation objective.

records.title: Photo intake validates hash syntax and rights label, not evidence
records.existing_behavior: Any 64-hex value and accepted rights_basis string can enter upgrade path without verifying bytes/rights reference.
records.required_behavior: Verify stored image bytes/hash, product/version association and recorded permission/license basis before use; retain held state otherwise.

records.title: Photo planning stops before review/publication but starts impact clock
records.existing_behavior: Unapproved proof row is added; upgrade_queued planning date starts before/after measurement without demonstrated review/publish chain.
records.required_behavior: Upgrade lifecycle must progress through review, recertification and authorized publication; impact anchored to actual exposed version/time.

records.title: Seller location opens a buyer-market evidence gate
records.existing_behavior: Shop location is stored as market and contributes to second-market gate.
records.required_behavior: Distinguish seller geography from observed buyer/query population; no Canadian/global demand claim from seller address.

records.title: Drift incidents resolve when evidence ages out or becomes unreadable
records.existing_behavior: Absent current gradual_drift resolves prior incident; batch count can be measurable despite insufficient readable dimensions.
records.required_behavior: Unknown/expired evidence must not establish recovery; only sufficient comparable stable evidence can resolve drift.

records.title: Benchmark-refresh trigger and purchased candidate can diverge
records.existing_behavior: Strong competitor trigger picks by pod, potentially from another seller; first-baseline no-ask prose conflicts with unconditionally generated leader triggers.
records.required_behavior: Request must answer the actual trigger and accurately state baseline policy; avoid duplicate purchased information.

records.title: Company standing and entry superiority rely on capability/count proxies
records.existing_behavior: Approved images across versions can inflate coverage; compiler-wide size capability can be claimed for unbuilt specific products.
records.required_behavior: Compare current applicable releases; separate potential engineering capability from demonstrated product advantage.

records.title: Quote-token heuristics cover only explicit title forms
records.existing_behavior: Heuristics detect quoted spans/qualifiers and some exclaimed memes, not all protected dialogue/lyrics in real inputs.
records.required_behavior: Do not infer comprehensive screening from limited token extraction; preserve existing rights gates and declared uncertainty.

records.title: Registry reclassification is not in the preserved patch
records.existing_behavior: No saved requirements.json edits implement claimed reclassification; synthetic gate fixture tests mechanics only.
records.required_behavior: Integrator alone reconciles genuine parks after built-half proof; do not restore obsolete parks to satisfy tests.

records.title: Collection patch context predates the fixed no-spin behavior
records.existing_behavior: Saved test context still expects requeued=True; latest checkpoint moved to certification-triggered collection work.
records.required_behavior: Preserve C-73 member-triggered, banded, idempotent collection execution plus Intel coherence refusal.

records.title: Duplicate promotion/referral readers can disagree
records.existing_behavior: Orders and Growth compute overlapping verdicts with different source/threshold assumptions.
records.required_behavior: One documented evidence/window/verdict contract per decision; divergent readers cannot independently authorize actions.

records.title: Combined model and registration changes lack integration evidence
records.existing_behavior: Three clusters add model fields and multiple clusters add handlers/grants/cadences; individual fresh DB tests do not prove populated DB compatibility.
records.required_behavior: Preserve data and register every new normal entry path in both fresh and upgraded databases without touching production.

records.title: Final protected actions must combine every applicable gate
records.existing_behavior: Gates are spread across planning, certification, asset and publication paths; clean merges can drop one or allow a stale decision.
records.required_behavior: Final authorized write/spend must consume current, hash-bound eligibility and budget/owner/policy state, including direct/retry/rebuild paths.

records.title: Test fixtures can conceal missing production evidence chains
records.existing_behavior: Several tests insert final evidence rows directly and then prove consumption.
records.required_behavior: Separate consumer-unit/handler proofs from full producer→consumer certification evidence.
